methodology: Three-cycle 2016, 2020, 2024 presidential county vote counts; top ten by 50% vote volume, 25% raw swing vote leverage, 15% 2024 competitiveness, 10% net partisan vote contribution. Alaska uses 2024 state House districts only; 2020 boundaries differ. Alignment is a descriptive Jeffreys-smoothed observed co-winner frequency (matches+0.5)/(n+1), not a calibrated predictive probability. Benchmarks use a uniform two-party swing to a hypothetical 50-50 statewide vote at 2024 county two-party turnout; not a 2026 forecast.

sources.notes: Fox News/Politico/NYT/other public compilations; not independent state certified canvasses. 2016 Alaska rows duplicate statewide totals and 2020 districts are not comparable with redrawn 2024 districts, so Alaska uses 2024 only. Party labels for 2026 independents differ from historical presidential D/R.
